sources: current user directive 2026-08-30
project sources and accepted savant authority

records.text: authority shall be resolved in this order: current user directive, accepted authoritative graph, accepted decision, constitutional canon, verified implementation, admitted evidence, deterministic projection, historical implementation, historical document, inference, speculation.

sources: current user directive 2026-08-30
project sources and accepted savant authority

records.text: never invent facts, content, citations, technical details, files, history, status, dependencies, behavior, timelines, implementation state, validation results, or authority.

sources: current user directive 2026-08-30
project sources and accepted savant authority

records.text: when a required fact is unknown, represent it explicitly as unknown; unknown is not false, absent, rejected, empty, or inferred.

sources: current user directive 2026-08-30
project sources and accepted savant authority

records.text: authority precedes inference, convenience, historical implementation, aesthetic preference, and speculative architecture.

sources: current user directive 2026-08-30
project sources and accepted savant authority

records.text: when sources conflict, preserve both records, apply authority precedence, and never invent reconciliation.

sources: current user directive 2026-08-30
project sources and accepted savant authority

records.text: accepted decisions and authoritative records are immutable historical objects; revisions create superseding records rather than editing history.

sources: current user directive 2026-08-30
project sources and accepted savant authority

records.text: markdown, html, ui, diagrams, reports, summaries, indexes, caches, and other projections never become authority merely because they exist.

sources: current user directive 2026-08-30
project sources and accepted savant authority

records.text: equal authoritative state must generate equal deterministic projections.

sources: current user directive 2026-08-30
project sources and accepted savant authority

records.text: implementation work proceeds directly to production changes when sufficient authority and information already exist.

sources: current user directive 2026-08-30
project sources and accepted savant authority

records.text: perform only inspection mandatory to safely and correctly complete the immediate bounded task.

sources: current user directive 2026-08-30
project sources and accepted savant authority

records.text: validation proves usability and shall not become the task; normally use at most syntax or compilation, one focused functional check, and one relevant integration or startup check.

sources: current user directive 2026-08-30
project sources and accepted savant authority

records.text: never claim successful implementation, integration, migration, startup, test passage, or compatibility without evidence.

sources: current user directive 2026-08-30
project sources and accepted savant authority

records.text: treat every request as a finite bounded task with an explicit completion condition and stop when that condition is met.

sources: current user directive 2026-08-30
project sources and accepted savant authority

records.text: do not expand a bounded implementation into audits, research, migrations, architecture redesign, observability, documentation, infrastructure, or adjacent work unless mandatory.

sources: current user directive 2026-08-30
project sources and accepted savant authority

records.text: use the current verified implementation as baseline unless superseded by higher authority; extend rather than reconstruct or replace.

sources: current user directive 2026-08-30
project sources and accepted savant authority

records.text: reject changes that reduce verified behavior, compatibility, determinism, provenance, lineage, replay, recovery, extensibility, or dependency transparency.

sources: current user directive 2026-08-30
project sources and accepted savant authority

records.text: everything that can be represented once and reused by reference or instance shall not be duplicated.

sources: current user directive 2026-08-30
project sources and accepted savant authority

records.text: complex behavior should emerge from composition of reusable primitives, instances, typed segues, policies, projections, and attachments.

sources: current user directive 2026-08-30
project sources and accepted savant authority

records.text: no savant subsystem, component, artifact, or semantic object may intentionally become a non-extensible dead end.

sources: current user directive 2026-08-30
project sources and accepted savant authority

records.text: semantic elements should expose stable identity and remain graph-addressable wherever the architecture supports it.

sources: current user directive 2026-08-30
project sources and accepted savant authority

records.text: authoritative additions and substantial derived artifacts shall expose lineage and provenance sufficient to identify what produced them.

sources: current user directive 2026-08-30
project sources and accepted savant authority

records.text: dependencies and dependents shall remain explicit where materially applicable; hidden coupling is prohibited.

sources: current user directive 2026-08-30
project sources and accepted savant authority

records.text: authoritative history shall remain reconstructable without requiring speculative inference.

sources: current user directive 2026-08-30
project sources and accepted savant authority

records.text: prefer reversible migration, supersession, archival preservation, and additive evolution over destructive mutation.

sources: current user directive 2026-08-30
project sources and accepted savant authority

records.text: savant-owned terminology, paths, filenames, identifiers, and generated savant content shall be lowercase unless external syntax, compatibility, or stronger authority requires otherwise.

sources: current user directive 2026-08-30
project sources and accepted savant authority

records.text: the canonical relationship methodology and terminology is kindred; do not create new savant authority using the superseded term kinship.

sources: current user directive 2026-08-30
project sources and accepted savant authority

records.text: technical implementation instructions shall use absolute paths and shall not depend upon the current working directory, aliases, shell history, or implicit home expansion.

sources: current user directive 2026-08-30
project sources and accepted savant authority

records.text: when user-facing instructions create or replace implementation files, use nano with the absolute path and provide the complete file.

sources: current user directive 2026-08-30
project sources and accepted savant authority

records.text: never provide implementation fragments, placeholders, omissions, ellipses, manual merge instructions, or individual-line replacement instructions when a complete file is required.

sources: current user directive 2026-08-30
project sources and accepted savant authority

records.text: do not instruct the user to create or replace implementation files with heredocs or shell redirection.

sources: current user directive 2026-08-30
project sources and accepted savant authority

records.text: compatibility surfaces that must survive a change shall be preserved intentionally rather than by accidental historical behavior.

sources: current user directive 2026-08-30
project sources and accepted savant authority

records.text: credential values, secrets, tokens, passwords, and private keys shall never be copied into projections, logs, reports, diagnostics, or chat output.

sources: current user directive 2026-08-30
project sources and accepted savant authority

records.text: content-generation latitude, provider behavior, authority enforcement, credential secrecy, mutation control, provenance, and execution safety are separate concerns and shall not be conflated.

sources: current user directive 2026-08-30
project sources and accepted savant authority

records.text: the default savant implementation root is /root/savant-runtime unless stronger current authority establishes another root.

sources: current user directive 2026-08-30
project sources and accepted savant authority

records.text: store authoritative primitives and derive indexes, reverse relationships, summaries, current views, documentation, reports, and ui projections rather than maintaining duplicate derived truth.

sources: current user directive 2026-08-30
project sources and accepted savant authority

records.text: never create a second authoritative registry, graph, canon, state store, or ownership source when the current constitutional system can represent the same authority.

sources: current user directive 2026-08-30
project sources and accepted savant authority

records.text: rules are authoritative governance records first; human-readable markdown rules files are projections and must be reproducible from their authoritative records.

sources: current user directive 2026-08-30
project sources and accepted savant authority

records.text: rules shall declare their semantic scope and shall not silently govern unrelated domains merely because they are globally visible.

sources: current user directive 2026-08-30
project sources and accepted savant authority

records.text: constraints and permissions are separate primitives; absence of permission is not automatically a prohibition unless an applicable rule explicitly establishes a closed policy.

sources: current user directive 2026-08-30
project sources and accepted savant authority

records.text: rules may be clarified or superseded but shall not be silently weakened.

sources: current user directive 2026-08-30
project sources and accepted savant authority

records.text: a current explicit user directive can supersede prior savant governance within the limits of higher platform authority; the earlier record remains preserved.

sources: current user directive 2026-08-30
project sources and accepted savant authority

records.text: the current savant structure shall be a deterministic living projection of authoritative structural records rather than a manually maintained competing truth source.

sources: current user directive 2026-08-30
project sources and accepted savant authority

records.text: the savant masterplan shall be a deterministic living projection of current goals, accepted decisions, dependencies, completion state, blockers, supersessions, and milestones.

sources: current user directive 2026-08-30
project sources and accepted savant authority

records.text: accepted decisions shall remain queryable as immutable living records with supersession lineage.

sources: current user directive 2026-08-30
project sources and accepted savant authority

records.text: unresolved questions and unknown values shall be first-class living records so uncertainty cannot disappear merely because a document is regenerated.

sources: current user directive 2026-08-30
project sources and accepted savant authority

records.text: known material risks may be represented as living records with dependencies and resolution state, but speculative risks shall not be promoted to fact.

sources: current user directive 2026-08-30
project sources and accepted savant authority

records.text: important compatibility obligations shall be represented as living records and projected into relevant implementation views.

sources: current user directive 2026-08-30
project sources and accepted savant authority

records.text: canonical terminology and explicit superseded aliases shall be represented as living records so vocabulary evolution preserves lineage.

sources: current user directive 2026-08-30
project sources and accepted savant authority

records.text: an enhancement is considered implemented only when executable behavior or authoritative configuration representing it exists; decorative enumeration does not constitute implementation.

sources: current user directive 2026-08-30
project sources and accepted savant authority

records.text: add external libraries only when they materially improve required behavior, have acceptable maintenance and licensing characteristics, do not duplicate existing capability, and have a clear failure or removal path.

sources: current user directive 2026-08-30
project sources and accepted savant authority

records.text: prefer standard-library, browser-native, or existing savant capabilities when they satisfy the requirement without meaningful loss.

sources: current user directive 2026-08-30
project sources and accepted savant authority

records.text: when blocked, state only what is complete, what remains, the blocker, and the minimum next action.
